items.text: Carl Lambrecht is an optical engineer and the owner of an optical instrument manufacturer in Highland Park. He has a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois. He is a Moraine Township Republican precinct committeeperson.

sentences.text: Carl Lambrecht is an optical engineer and the owner of an optical instrument manufacturer in Highland Park.
He has a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois.
He is a Moraine Township Republican precinct committeeperson.

items.text: During his 2024 state house campaign, he advocated reducing the number of taxing bodies and school districts. He supported cutting the state gasoline tax in half. He called for ending state subsidies for an electric-vehicle battery plant and electric-car purchases. In a 2024 candidate questionnaire, he said, "Stop giving money to China to build a battery factory in Illinois."
